title: Chris Aubeck's book 'Saucers' shows saucer shapes are rare

tellings.quote: he's fantastic. His books are fantastic

plain: A book called Saucers, by the researcher Chris Aubeck, is said to show that the classic flying-saucer shape is actually rare among UFO reports, which would mean the popular image of a UFO doesn't match what witnesses usually describe. A researcher named Clas Svahn brings the book up on the show without saying where in it this appears, and he praises Aubeck highly: "he's fantastic. His books are fantastic."
